This individual was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], this [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually achieving the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Active in the year [[340 BBY]], they successfully averted an assassination attempt on a public official. Reporting back to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], this individual filed an official report with the [[Unidentified High Master|current]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the age.<ref name="TCOPL" />

Long after this Jedi's time, a recording of his meeting with the Grand Master was discovered to have survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Rescued from the Temple by the [[Last Curator of Records]], the files were viewed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] while rummaging through the Curator's belongings.<ref name="TCOPL" />
